title: Patch: cap every mana amount and every chosen X at 15
notes: Issue #5148 (R5148000): a player holds at most MANA_CEILING (15) mana, current or maximum, temporary mana included (every gain, a refresh and its riders, persistent modifiers, crystal steals); what would pass it is lost. A chosen, cast, set or counted X is at most 15, under a credit line (R1223) and infinite mana (R3548004) too. Costs are not capped: infinite mana still pays Core #100 Ceaseless Void at (16) or more. Asked for as a preemptive counter to infinite mana dealing unbounded damage. S #153 Stimmycheck, a (0) gain of 1 mana that returns each turn, is the card classify finds playing differently.

player.title: Mana and X capped at 15
changes: You can hold at most 15 mana. Mana you would gain past 15, temporary mana included, is lost.
An X is at most 15, however much mana you have, borrowed mana and infinite mana included.
Card costs are not capped: infinite mana still lets you play Ceaseless Void while it costs (16) or more.
